mode.name: mode
mode.comment:
Creates a ReadableStreamBYOBReader and locks the stream to the new reader.

This call behaves the same way as the no-argument variant, except that it only works on readable byte streams, i.e. streams which were constructed specifically with the ability to handle "bring your own buffer" reading. The returned BYOB reader provides the ability to directly read individual chunks from the stream via its read() method, into developer-supplied buffers, allowing more precise control over allocation.

preventCancel.name: preventCancel
preventCancel.comment:
Asynchronously iterates over the chunks in the stream's internal queue.

Asynchronously iterating over the stream will lock it, preventing any other consumer from acquiring a reader. The lock will be released if the async iterator's return() method is called, e.g. by breaking out of the loop.

By default, calling the async iterator's return() method will also cancel the stream. To prevent this, use the stream's values() method, passing true for the preventCancel option.

writable.name: writable
writable.comment:
Provides a convenient, chainable way of piping this readable stream through a transform stream (or any other { writable, readable } pair). It simply pipes the stream into the writable side of the supplied pair, and returns the readable side for further use.

Piping a stream will lock it for the duration of the pipe, preventing any other consumer from acquiring a reader.

preventClose.name: preventClose
preventClose.comment:
Pipes this readable stream to a given writable stream destination. The way in which the piping process behaves under various error conditions can be customized with a number of passed options. It returns a promise that fulfills when the piping process completes successfully, or rejects if any errors were encountered.

Piping a stream will lock it for the duration of the pipe, preventing any other consumer from acquiring a reader.

Errors and closures of the source and destination streams propagate as follows:

An error in this source readable stream will abort destination, unless preventAbort is truthy. The returned promise will be rejected with the source's error, or with any error that occurs during aborting the destination.

An error in destination will cancel this source readable stream, unless preventCancel is truthy. The returned promise will be rejected with the destination's error, or with any error that occurs during canceling the source.

When this source readable stream closes, destination will be closed, unless preventClose is truthy. The returned promise will be fulfilled once this process completes, unless an error is encountered while closing the destination, in which case it will be rejected with that error.

If destination starts out closed or closing, this source readable stream will be canceled, unless preventCancel is true. The returned promise will be rejected with an error indicating piping to a closed stream failed, or with any error that occurs during canceling the source.

The signal option can be set to an AbortSignal to allow aborting an ongoing pipe operation via the corresponding AbortController. In this case, this source readable stream will be canceled, and destination aborted, unless the respective options preventCancel or preventAbort are set.

highWaterMark.name: highWaterMark
highWaterMark.comment:
Creates a new ByteLengthQueuingStrategy with the provided high water mark.

Note that the provided high water mark will not be validated ahead of time. Instead, if it is negative, NaN, or not a number, the resulting ByteLengthQueuingStrategy will cause the corresponding stream constructor to throw.

IDBObjectStore.name: IDBObjectStore

put.name: put
put.comment:
Adds or updates a record in store with the given value and key.

If the store uses in-line keys and key is specified a "DataError" DOMException will be thrown.

If put() is used, any existing record with the key will be replaced. If add() is used, and if a record with the key already exists the request will fail, with request's error set to a "ConstraintError" DOMException.

If successful, request's result will be the record's key.

add.name: add
add.comment:
Adds or updates a record in store with the given value and key.

If the store uses in-line keys and key is specified a "DataError" DOMException will be thrown.

If put() is used, any existing record with the key will be replaced. If add() is used, and if a record with the key already exists the request will fail, with request's error set to a "ConstraintError" DOMException.

If successful, request's result will be the record's key.

delete.name: delete
delete.comment:
Deletes records in store with the given key or in the given key range in query.

If successful, request's result will be undefined.

clear.name: clear
clear.comment:
Deletes all records in store.

If successful, request's result will be undefined.

get.name: get
get.comment:

If successful, request's result will be the value, or undefined if there was no matching record.

getKey.name: getKey
getKey.comment:
Retrieves the key of the first record matching the given key or key range in query.

If successful, request's result will be the key, or undefined if there was no matching record.

getAll.name: getAll
getAll.comment:

getAllKeys.name: getAllKeys
getAllKeys.comment:
Retrieves the keys of records matching the given key or key range in query (up to count if given).

If successful, request's result will be an Array of the keys.

count.name: count
count.comment:
Retrieves the number of records matching the given key or key range in query.

If successful, request's result will be the count.

openCursor.name: openCursor
openCursor.comment:
Opens a cursor over the records matching query, ordered by direction. If query is null, all records in store are matched.

If successful, request's result will be an IDBCursorWithValue pointing at the first matching record, or null if there were no matching records.

openKeyCursor.name: openKeyCursor
openKeyCursor.comment:
Opens a cursor with key only flag set over the records matching query, ordered by direction. If query is null, all records in store are matched.

If successful, request's result will be an IDBCursor pointing at the first matching record, or null if there were no matching records.

createIndex.name: createIndex

Throws an "InvalidStateError" DOMException if not called within an upgrade transaction.

deleteIndex.name: deleteIndex

autoIncrement.comment: Returns true if the store has a key generator, and false otherwise.

IDBCursor.name: IDBCursor

advance.comment: Advances the cursor through the next count records in range.

continue.comment: Advances the cursor to the next record in range.

continuePrimaryKey.comment: Advances the cursor to the next record in range matching or after key and primaryKey. Throws an "InvalidAccessError" DOMException if the source is not an index.

update.name: update
update.comment:
Updated the record pointed at by the cursor with a new value.

addEventListener.name: addEventListener
addEventListener.comment:
Appends an event listener for events whose type attribute value is type. The callback argument sets the callback that will be invoked when the event is dispatched.

The options argument sets listener-specific options. For compatibility this can be a boolean, in which case the method behaves exactly as if the value was specified as options's capture.

When set to true, options's capture prevents callback from being invoked when the event's eventPhase attribute value is BUBBLING_PHASE. When false (or not present), callback will not be invoked when event's eventPhase attribute value is CAPTURING_PHASE. Either way, callback will be invoked if event's eventPhase attribute value is AT_TARGET.

When set to true, options's passive indicates that the callback will not cancel the event by invoking preventDefault(). This is used to enable performance optimizations described in § 2.8 Observing event listeners.

When set to true, options's once indicates that the callback will only be invoked once after which the event listener will be removed.

If an AbortSignal is passed for options's signal, then the event listener will be removed when signal is aborted.

The event listener is appended to target's event listener list and is not appended if it has the same type, callback, and capture.

removeEventListener.comment: Removes the event listener in target's event listener list with the same type, callback, and options.

dispatchEvent.name: dispatchEvent
dispatchEvent.comment: Dispatches a synthetic event event to target and returns true if either event's cancelable attribute value is false or its preventDefault() method was not invoked, and false otherwise.

localName does not match the QName production.
Namespace prefix is not null and namespace is the empty string.
Namespace prefix is "xml" and namespace is not the XML namespace.
qualifiedName or namespace prefix is "xmlns" and namespace is not the XMLNS namespace.
namespace is the XMLNS namespace and neither qualifiedName nor namespace prefix is "xmlns".

getSelection.name: getSelection
getSelection.comment: Returns an object representing the current selection of the document that is loaded into the object displaying a webpage.

caretRangeFromPoint.name: caretRangeFromPoint
overrideSignatures: caretRangeFromPoint(x: number, y: number): Range | null

getElementById.name: getElementById
getElementById.comment:
Returns a reference to the first object with the specified value of the ID attribute.
@param elementId String that specifies the ID value.

implementation.name: implementation
implementation.comment: Gets the implementation object of the current document.

URL.name: URL
URL.comment: Sets or gets the URL for the current document.

compatMode.name: compatMode
compatMode.comment: Gets a value that indicates whether standards-compliant mode is switched on for the object.

charset.name: charset
charset.deprecated: This is a legacy alias of `characterSet`.
charset.comment: Gets or sets the character set used to encode the object.

inputEncoding.name: inputEncoding
inputEncoding.deprecated: This is a legacy alias of `characterSet`.
inputEncoding.comment: Returns the character encoding used to create the webpage that is loaded into the document object.

doctype.name: doctype
doctype.comment: Gets an object representing the document type declaration associated with the current document.

documentElement.name: documentElement
documentElement.comment: Gets a reference to the root node of the document.

fullscreenEnabled.name: fullscreenEnabled
fullscreenEnabled.comment: Returns true if document has the ability to display elements fullscreen and fullscreen is supported, or false otherwise.

location.name: location
location.comment: Contains information about the current URL.

domain.name: domain
domain.comment: Sets or gets the security domain of the document.

referrer.name: referrer
referrer.comment: Gets the URL of the location that referred the user to the current page.

cookie.name: cookie
cookie.comment:
Returns the HTTP cookies that apply to the Document. If there are no cookies or cookies can't be applied to this resource, the empty string will be returned.

Can be set, to add a new cookie to the element's set of HTTP cookies.

If the contents are sandboxed into a unique origin (e.g. in an iframe with the sandbox attribute), a "SecurityError" DOMException will be thrown on getting and setting.

lastModified.name: lastModified
lastModified.comment: Gets the date that the page was last modified, if the page supplies one.

readyState.name: readyState
readyState.comment: Retrieves a value that indicates the current state of the object.

title.name: title
title.comment: Contains the title of the document.

dir.name: dir
dir.comment: Sets or retrieves a value that indicates the reading order of the object.

body.name: body
body.comment: Specifies the beginning and end of the document body.

images.name: images
images.comment: Retrieves a collection, in source order, of img objects in the document.

embeds.name: embeds
embeds.comment: Retrieves a collection of all embed objects in the document.

plugins.name: plugins
plugins.comment: Return an HTMLCollection of the embed elements in the Document.

links.name: links
links.comment: Retrieves a collection of all a objects that specify the href property and all area objects in the document.

forms.name: forms
forms.comment: Retrieves a collection, in source order, of all form objects in the document.

scripts.name: scripts
scripts.comment: Retrieves a collection of all script objects in the document.

currentScript.name: currentScript
currentScript.comment:
Returns the script element, or the SVG script element, that is currently executing, as long as the element represents a classic script. In the case of reentrant script execution, returns the one that most recently started executing amongst those that have not yet finished executing.

Returns null if the Document is not currently executing a script or SVG script element (e.g., because the running script is an event handler, or a timeout), or if the currently executing script or SVG script element represents a module script.

defaultView.name: defaultView
defaultView.comment: Returns the Window object of the active document.

designMode.name: designMode
designMode.comment: Sets or gets a value that indicates whether the document can be edited.

onreadystatechange.name: onreadystatechange
onreadystatechange.comment:
Fires when the state of the object has changed.
@param ev The event

fgColor.name: fgColor
fgColor.comment: Sets or gets the foreground (text) color of the document.

linkColor.name: linkColor
linkColor.comment: Sets or gets the color of the document links.

vlinkColor.name: vlinkColor
vlinkColor.comment: Sets or gets the color of the links that the user has visited.

alinkColor.name: alinkColor
alinkColor.comment: Sets or gets the color of all active links in the document.

bgColor.name: bgColor
bgColor.comment: Deprecated. Sets or retrieves a value that indicates the background color behind the object.

anchors.name: anchors
anchors.comment: Retrieves a collection of all a objects that have a name and/or id property. Objects in this collection are in HTML source order.

applets.name: applets
applets.comment: Retrieves a collection of all applet objects in the document.

all.name: all
all.comment: Returns a reference to the collection of elements contained by the object.

Document.comment: Any web page loaded in the browser and serves as an entry point into the web page's content, which is the DOM tree.

XMLDocument.name: XMLDocument
XMLDocument.comment: An XML document. It inherits from the generic Document and does not add any specific methods or properties to it: nevertheless, several algorithms behave differently with the two types of documents.

DOMImplementation.name: DOMImplementation
DOMImplementation.comment: An object providing methods which are not dependent on any particular document. Such an object is returned by the Document.implementation property.

DocumentFragment.name: DocumentFragment
DocumentFragment.comment: A minimal document object that has no parent. It is used as a lightweight version of Document that stores a segment of a document structure comprised of nodes just like a standard document. The key difference is that because the document fragment isn't part of the active document tree structure, changes made to the fragment don't affect the document, cause reflow, or incur any performance impact that can occur when changes are made.

cloneNode.comment: Throws a "NotSupportedError" DOMException if context object is a shadow root.

Element.name: Element

hasAttributes.name: hasAttributes
hasAttributes.comment: Returns true if element has attributes, and false otherwise.

getAttributeNames.name: getAttributeNames
getAttributeNames.comment: Returns the qualified names of all element's attributes. Can contain duplicates.

getAttribute.name: getAttribute
getAttribute.comment: Returns element's first attribute whose qualified name is qualifiedName, and null if there is no such attribute otherwise.

getAttributeNS.name: getAttributeNS
getAttributeNS.comment: Returns element's attribute whose namespace is namespace and local name is localName, and null if there is no such attribute otherwise.

setAttribute.name: setAttribute
setAttribute.comment: Sets the value of element's first attribute whose qualified name is qualifiedName to value.

setAttributeNS.name: setAttributeNS
setAttributeNS.comment: Sets the value of element's attribute whose namespace is namespace and local name is localName to value.

removeAttribute.name: removeAttribute
removeAttribute.comment: Removes element's first attribute whose qualified name is qualifiedName.

removeAttributeNS.name: removeAttributeNS
removeAttributeNS.comment: Removes element's attribute whose namespace is namespace and local name is localName.

toggleAttribute.name: toggleAttribute
toggleAttribute.comment:
If force is not given, "toggles" qualifiedName, removing it if it is present and adding it if it is not present. If force is true, adds qualifiedName. If force is false, removes qualifiedName.

Returns true if qualifiedName is now present, and false otherwise.

hasAttribute.name: hasAttribute
hasAttribute.comment: Returns true if element has an attribute whose qualified name is qualifiedName, and false otherwise.

hasAttributeNS.name: hasAttributeNS
hasAttributeNS.comment: Returns true if element has an attribute whose namespace is namespace and local name is localName.

attachShadow.name: attachShadow
attachShadow.comment: Creates a shadow root for element and returns it.

closest.name: closest
closest.comment: Returns the first (starting at element) inclusive ancestor that matches selectors, and null otherwise.
additionalSignatures: closest<K extends keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap>(selector: K): HTMLElementTagNameMap[K] | null
closest<K extends keyof SVGElementTagNameMap>(selector: K): SVGElementTagNameMap[K] | null
closest<K extends keyof MathMLElementTagNameMap>(selector: K): MathMLElementTagNameMap[K] | null

matches.name: matches
matches.comment: Returns true if matching selectors against element's root yields element, and false otherwise.

webkitMatchesSelector.name: webkitMatchesSelector
webkitMatchesSelector.deprecated: This is a legacy alias of `matches`.

getElementsByClassName.name: getElementsByClassName
getElementsByClassName.comment: Returns a HTMLCollection of the elements in the object on which the method was invoked (a document or an element) that have all the classes given by classNames. The classNames argument is interpreted as a space-separated list of classes.

requestFullscreen.name: requestFullscreen
requestFullscreen.comment:
Displays element fullscreen and resolves promise when done.

When supplied, options's navigationUI member indicates whether showing navigation UI while in fullscreen is preferred or not. If set to "show", navigation simplicity is preferred over screen space, and if set to "hide", more screen space is preferred. User agents are always free to honor user preference over the application's. The default value "auto" indicates no application preference.

id.name: id
id.comment: Returns the value of element's id content attribute. Can be set to change it.

className.name: className
className.comment: Returns the value of element's class content attribute. Can be set to change it.

classList.name: classList
classList.comment: Allows for manipulation of element's class content attribute as a set of whitespace-separated tokens through a DOMTokenList object.

slot.name: slot
slot.comment: Returns the value of element's slot content attribute. Can be set to change it.

shadowRoot.name: shadowRoot
shadowRoot.comment: Returns element's shadow root, if any, and if shadow root's mode is "open", and null otherwise.

Element.comment: Element is the most general base class from which all objects in a Document inherit. It only has methods and properties common to all kinds of elements. More specific classes inherit from Element.

NamedNodeMap.name: NamedNodeMap
NamedNodeMap.comment: A collection of Attr objects. Objects inside a NamedNodeMap are not in any particular order, unlike NodeList, although they may be accessed by an index as in an array.

Attr.name: Attr
Attr.comment: A DOM element's attribute as an object. In most DOM methods, you will probably directly retrieve the attribute as a string (e.g., Element.getAttribute(), but certain functions (e.g., Element.getAttributeNode()) or means of iterating give Attr types.

CharacterData.name: CharacterData
CharacterData.comment: The CharacterData abstract interface represents a Node object that contains characters. This is an abstract interface, meaning there aren't any object of type CharacterData: it is implemented by other interfaces, like Text, Comment, or ProcessingInstruction which aren't abstract.

Text.name: Text

splitText.name: splitText
splitText.comment: Splits data at the given offset and returns the remainder as Text node.

wholeText.name: wholeText
wholeText.comment: Returns the combined data of all direct Text node siblings.

Text.comment: The textual content of Element or Attr. If an element has no markup within its content, it has a single child implementing Text that contains the element's text. However, if the element contains markup, it is parsed into information items and Text nodes that form its children.

CDATASection.name: CDATASection
CDATASection.comment: A CDATA section that can be used within XML to include extended portions of unescaped text. The symbols < and & don’t need escaping as they normally do when inside a CDATA section.

ProcessingInstruction.name: ProcessingInstruction
ProcessingInstruction.comment: A processing instruction embeds application-specific instructions in XML which can be ignored by other applications that don't recognize them.

Comment.name: Comment
Comment.comment: Textual notations within markup; although it is generally not visually shown, such comments are available to be read in the source view.

collapsed.name: collapsed
collapsed.comment: Returns true if range is collapsed, and false otherwise.

Range.name: Range

comparePoint.name: comparePoint
comparePoint.comment: Returns −1 if the point is before the range, 0 if the point is in the range, and 1 if the point is after the range.

commonAncestorContainer.name: commonAncestorContainer
commonAncestorContainer.comment: Returns the node, furthest away from the document, that is an ancestor of both range's start node and end node.

Range.comment: A fragment of a document that can contain nodes and parts of text nodes.

NodeIterator.name: NodeIterator
NodeIterator.comment: An iterator over the members of a list of the nodes in a subtree of the DOM. The nodes will be returned in document order.

TreeWalker.name: TreeWalker
TreeWalker.comment: The nodes of a document subtree and a position within them.

DOMTokenList.name: DOMTokenList

item.name: item
item.comment: Returns the token with index index.

contains.name: contains
contains.comment: Returns true if token is present, and false otherwise.

add.name: add
add.comment:
Adds all arguments passed, except those already present.

Throws a "SyntaxError" DOMException if one of the arguments is the empty string.

Throws an "InvalidCharacterError" DOMException if one of the arguments contains any ASCII whitespace.

remove.name: remove
remove.comment:
Removes arguments passed, if they are present.

Throws a "SyntaxError" DOMException if one of the arguments is the empty string.

Throws an "InvalidCharacterError" DOMException if one of the arguments contains any ASCII whitespace.

toggle.name: toggle
toggle.comment:
If force is not given, "toggles" token, removing it if it's present and adding it if it's not present. If force is true, adds token (same as add()). If force is false, removes token (same as remove()).

Returns true if token is now present, and false otherwise.

Throws a "SyntaxError" DOMException if token is empty.

Throws an "InvalidCharacterError" DOMException if token contains any spaces.

replace.name: replace
replace.comment:
Replaces token with newToken.

Returns true if token was replaced with newToken, and false otherwise.

Throws a "SyntaxError" DOMException if one of the arguments is the empty string.

Throws an "InvalidCharacterError" DOMException if one of the arguments contains any ASCII whitespace.

supports.name: supports
supports.comment:
Returns true if token is in the associated attribute's supported tokens. Returns false otherwise.

Throws a TypeError if the associated attribute has no supported tokens defined.

value.name: value
value.comment:
Returns the associated set as string.

Can be set, to change the associated attribute.

DOMTokenList.comment: A set of space-separated tokens. Such a set is returned by Element.classList, HTMLLinkElement.relList, HTMLAnchorElement.relList, HTMLAreaElement.relList, HTMLIframeElement.sandbox, or HTMLOutputElement.htmlFor. It is indexed beginning with 0 as with JavaScript Array objects. DOMTokenList is always case-sensitive.

XPathResult.name: XPathResult
XPathResult.comment: The results generated by evaluating an XPath expression within the context of a given node.

XPathExpression.name: XPathExpression
XPathExpression.comment: This interface is a compiled XPath expression that can be evaluated on a document or specific node to return information its DOM tree.

XPathEvaluator.name: XPathEvaluator
XPathEvaluator.comment: The XPathEvaluator interface allows to compile and evaluate XPath expressions.

XSLTProcessor.name: XSLTProcessor
XSLTProcessor.comment: An XSLTProcessor applies an XSLT stylesheet transformation to an XML document to produce a new XML document as output. It has methods to load the XSLT stylesheet, to manipulate <xsl:param> parameter values, and to apply the transformation to documents.

TextDecoder.name: TextDecoder

decode.name: decode

TextDecoder.comment: A decoder for a specific method, that is a specific character encoding, like utf-8, iso-8859-2, koi8, cp1261, gbk, etc. A decoder takes a stream of bytes as input and emits a stream of code points. For a more scalable, non-native library, see StringView – a C-like representation of strings based on typed arrays.

TextEncoder.name: TextEncoder

encode.name: encode
encode.comment: Returns the result of running UTF-8's encoder.

encodeInto.name: encodeInto
encodeInto.comment: Runs the UTF-8 encoder on source, stores the result of that operation into destination, and returns the progress made as an object wherein read is the number of converted code units of source and written is the number of bytes modified in destination.

TextEncoder.comment: TextEncoder takes a stream of code points as input and emits a stream of bytes. For a more scalable, non-native library, see StringView – a C-like representation of strings based on typed arrays.

MediaKeySystemAccess.name: MediaKeySystemAccess
MediaKeySystemAccess.comment: This EncryptedMediaExtensions API interface provides access to a Key System for decryption and/or a content protection provider. You can request an instance of this object using the Navigator.requestMediaKeySystemAccess method.

MediaKeys.name: MediaKeys
MediaKeys.comment: This EncryptedMediaExtensions API interface the represents a set of keys that an associated HTMLMediaElement can use for decryption of media data during playback.

MediaKeySession.name: MediaKeySession
MediaKeySession.comment: This EncryptedMediaExtensions API interface represents a context for message exchange with a content decryption module (CDM).

MediaKeyStatusMap.name: MediaKeyStatusMap
MediaKeyStatusMap.comment: This EncryptedMediaExtensions API interface is a read-only map of media key statuses by key IDs.

MediaKeyMessageEvent.name: MediaKeyMessageEvent
MediaKeyMessageEvent.comment: This EncryptedMediaExtensions API interface contains the content and related data when the content decryption module generates a message for the session.

Headers.name: Headers

comment.entries: Returns an iterator allowing to go through all key/value pairs contained in this object.
comment.keys: Returns an iterator allowing to go through all keys of the key/value pairs contained in this object.
comment.values: Returns an iterator allowing to go through all values of the key/value pairs contained in this object.

Headers.comment: This Fetch API interface allows you to perform various actions on HTTP request and response headers. These actions include retrieving, setting, adding to, and removing. A Headers object has an associated header list, which is initially empty and consists of zero or more name and value pairs.  You can add to this using methods like append() (see Examples.) In all methods of this interface, header names are matched by case-insensitive byte sequence.

Request.name: Request

method.name: method
method.comment: Returns request's HTTP method, which is "GET" by default.

url.name: url
url.comment: Returns the URL of request as a string.

headers.name: headers
headers.comment: Returns a Headers object consisting of the headers associated with request. Note that headers added in the network layer by the user agent will not be accounted for in this object, e.g., the "Host" header.

destination.name: destination
destination.comment: Returns the kind of resource requested by request, e.g., "document" or "script".

referrer.name: referrer
referrer.comment: Returns the referrer of request. Its value can be a same-origin URL if explicitly set in init, the empty string to indicate no referrer, and "about:client" when defaulting to the global's default. This is used during fetching to determine the value of the `Referer` header of the request being made.

referrerPolicy.name: referrerPolicy
referrerPolicy.comment: Returns the referrer policy associated with request. This is used during fetching to compute the value of the request's referrer.

mode.name: mode
mode.comment: Returns the mode associated with request, which is a string indicating whether the request will use CORS, or will be restricted to same-origin URLs.

credentials.name: credentials
credentials.comment: Returns the credentials mode associated with request, which is a string indicating whether credentials will be sent with the request always, never, or only when sent to a same-origin URL.

cache.name: cache
cache.comment: Returns the cache mode associated with request, which is a string indicating how the request will interact with the browser's cache when fetching.

redirect.name: redirect
redirect.comment: Returns the redirect mode associated with request, which is a string indicating how redirects for the request will be handled during fetching. A request will follow redirects by default.

integrity.name: integrity
integrity.comment: Returns request's subresource integrity metadata, which is a cryptographic hash of the resource being fetched. Its value consists of multiple hashes separated by whitespace. [SRI]

keepalive.name: keepalive
keepalive.comment: Returns a boolean indicating whether or not request can outlive the global in which it was created.

signal.name: signal
signal.comment: Returns the signal associated with request, which is an AbortSignal object indicating whether or not request has been aborted, and its abort event handler.

Request.comment: This Fetch API interface represents a resource request.

Response.name: Response
Response.comment: This Fetch API interface represents the response to a request.

SVGFilterElement.name: SVGFilterElement
SVGFilterElement.comment: Provides access to the properties of <filter> elements, as well as methods to manipulate them.

SVGComponentTransferFunctionElement.name: SVGComponentTransferFunctionElement
SVGComponentTransferFunctionElement.comment: A base interface used by the component transfer function interfaces.

Gamepad.name: Gamepad
Gamepad.comment: This Gamepad API interface defines an individual gamepad or other controller, allowing access to information such as button presses, axis positions, and id.

GamepadButton.name: GamepadButton
GamepadButton.comment: An individual button of a gamepad or other controller, allowing access to the current state of different types of buttons available on the control device.

GamepadHapticActuator.name: GamepadHapticActuator
GamepadHapticActuator.comment: This Gamepad API interface represents hardware in the controller designed to provide haptic feedback to the user (if available), most commonly vibration hardware.

GamepadEvent.name: GamepadEvent
GamepadEvent.comment: This Gamepad API interface contains references to gamepads connected to the system, which is what the gamepad events Window.gamepadconnected and Window.gamepaddisconnected are fired in response to.

Geolocation.name: Geolocation
Geolocation.comment: An object able to programmatically obtain the position of the device. It gives Web content access to the location of the device. This allows a Web site or app to offer customized results based on the user's location.

Performance.name: Performance
Performance.comment: Provides access to performance-related information for the current page. It's part of the High Resolution Time API, but is enhanced by the Performance Timeline API, the Navigation Timing API, the User Timing API, and the Resource Timing API.

namedItem.name: namedItem
namedItem.comment:
Returns the item with ID or name name from the collection.

If there are multiple matching items, then an HTMLCollection object containing all those elements is returned.

Only button, form, iframe, input, map, meta, object, select, and textarea elements can have a name for the purpose of this method; their name is given by the value of their name attribute.

item.name: item
item.comment: Returns the item with index index from the collection (determined by tree order).

length.name: length
length.comment: Returns the number of elements in the collection.

HTMLFormControlsCollection.name: HTMLFormControlsCollection

namedItem.name: namedItem
namedItem.comment:
Returns the item with ID or name name from the collection.

If there are multiple matching items, then a RadioNodeList object containing all those elements is returned.

HTMLFormControlsCollection.comment: A collection of HTML form control elements.

HTMLOptionsCollection.name: HTMLOptionsCollection

add.name: add
add.comment:
Inserts element before the node given by before.

The before argument can be a number, in which case element is inserted before the item with that number, or an element from the collection, in which case element is inserted before that element.

If before is omitted, null, or a number out of range, then element will be added at the end of the list.

This method will throw a "HierarchyRequestError" DOMException if element is an ancestor of the element into which it is to be inserted.

remove.name: remove
remove.comment: Removes the item with index index from the collection.

length.name: length
length.comment:
Returns the number of elements in the collection.

When set to a smaller number, truncates the number of option elements in the corresponding container.

When set to a greater number, adds new blank option elements to that container.

selectedIndex.name: selectedIndex
selectedIndex.comment:
Returns the index of the first selected item, if any, or −1 if there is no selected item.

Can be set, to change the selection.

HTMLOptionsCollection.comment: HTMLOptionsCollection is an interface representing a collection of HTML option elements (in document order) and offers methods and properties for traversing the list as well as optionally altering its items. This type is returned solely by the "options" property of select.

DOMStringList.name: DOMStringList

item.name: item
item.comment: Returns the string with index index from strings.

contains.name: contains
contains.comment: Returns true if strings contains string, and false otherwise.

length.name: length
length.comment: Returns the number of strings in strings.

DOMStringList.comment: A type returned by some APIs which contains a list of DOMString (strings).

HTMLElement.name: HTMLElement
HTMLElement.comment: Any HTML element. Some elements directly implement this interface, while others implement it via an interface that inherits it.

HTMLUnknownElement.name: HTMLUnknownElement
HTMLUnknownElement.comment: An invalid HTML element and derives from the HTMLElement interface, but without implementing any additional properties or methods.

DOMStringMap.name: DOMStringMap
DOMStringMap.comment: Used by the dataset HTML attribute to represent data for custom attributes added to elements.

HTMLHtmlElement.name: HTMLHtmlElement

version.name: version
version.comment: Sets or retrieves the DTD version that governs the current document.

HTMLHtmlElement.comment: Serves as the root node for a given HTML document. This object inherits the properties and methods described in the HTMLElement interface.

HTMLHeadElement.name: HTMLHeadElement
HTMLHeadElement.comment: Contains the descriptive information, or metadata, for a document. This object inherits all of the properties and methods described in the HTMLElement interface.

HTMLTitleElement.name: HTMLTitleElement

text.name: text
text.comment: Retrieves or sets the text of the object as a string.

HTMLTitleElement.comment: Contains the title for a document. This element inherits all of the properties and methods of the HTMLElement interface.

HTMLBaseElement.name: HTMLBaseElement

href.name: href
href.comment: Gets or sets the baseline URL on which relative links are based.

target.name: target
target.comment: Sets or retrieves the window or frame at which to target content.

HTMLBaseElement.comment: Contains the base URI for a document. This object inherits all of the properties and methods as described in the HTMLElement interface.

HTMLLinkElement.name: HTMLLinkElement

href.name: href
href.comment: Sets or retrieves a destination URL or an anchor point.

rel.name: rel
rel.comment: Sets or retrieves the relationship between the object and the destination of the link.

media.name: media
media.comment: Sets or retrieves the media type.

hreflang.name: hreflang
hreflang.comment: Sets or retrieves the language code of the object.

type.name: type
type.comment: Sets or retrieves the MIME type of the object.

charset.name: charset
charset.comment: Sets or retrieves the character set used to encode the object.

rev.name: rev
rev.comment: Sets or retrieves the relationship between the object and the destination of the link.

target.name: target
target.comment: Sets or retrieves the window or frame at which to target content.

HTMLLinkElement.comment: Reference information for external resources and the relationship of those resources to a document and vice-versa. This object inherits all of the properties and methods of the HTMLElement interface.

HTMLMetaElement.name: HTMLMetaElement

name.name: name
name.comment: Sets or retrieves the value specified in the content attribute of the meta object.

httpEquiv.name: httpEquiv
httpEquiv.comment: Gets or sets information used to bind the value of a content attribute of a meta element to an HTTP response header.

content.name: content
content.comment: Gets or sets meta-information to associate with httpEquiv or name.

scheme.name: scheme
scheme.comment: Sets or retrieves a scheme to be used in interpreting the value of a property specified for the object.

HTMLMetaElement.comment: Contains descriptive metadata about a document. It inherits all of the properties and methods described in the HTMLElement interface.

HTMLStyleElement.name: HTMLStyleElement

disabled.name: disabled
disabled.comment: Enables or disables the style sheet.

media.name: media
media.comment: Sets or retrieves the media type.

type.name: type
type.comment: Retrieves the CSS language in which the style sheet is written.

HTMLStyleElement.comment: A <style> element. It inherits properties and methods from its parent, HTMLElement, and from LinkStyle.

HTMLBodyElement.name: HTMLBodyElement
HTMLBodyElement.comment: Provides special properties (beyond those inherited from the regular HTMLElement interface) for manipulating <body> elements.

HTMLHeadingElement.name: HTMLHeadingElement

align.name: align
align.comment: Sets or retrieves a value that indicates the table alignment.

HTMLHeadingElement.comment: The different heading elements. It inherits methods and properties from the HTMLElement interface.

HTMLParagraphElement.name: HTMLParagraphElement

align.name: align
align.comment: Sets or retrieves how the object is aligned with adjacent text.

HTMLParagraphElement.comment:
Provides special properties (beyond those of the regular HTMLElement object interface it inherits) for manipulating

elements.

HTMLHRElement.name: HTMLHRElement

align.name: align
align.comment: Sets or retrieves how the object is aligned with adjacent text.

noShade.name: noShade
noShade.comment: Sets or retrieves whether the horizontal rule is drawn with 3-D shading.

width.name: width
width.comment: Sets or retrieves the width of the object.

HTMLHRElement.comment: Provides special properties (beyond those of the HTMLElement interface it also has available to it by inheritance) for manipulating <hr> elements.

HTMLPreElement.name: HTMLPreElement

width.name: width
width.comment: Sets or gets a value that you can use to implement your own width functionality for the object.

HTMLPreElement.comment: Exposes specific properties and methods (beyond those of the HTMLElement interface it also has available to it by inheritance) for manipulating a block of preformatted text (<pre>).

HTMLQuoteElement.name: HTMLQuoteElement

cite.name: cite
cite.comment: Sets or retrieves reference information about the object.

HTMLQuoteElement.comment: Provides special properties and methods (beyond the regular HTMLElement interface it also has available to it by inheritance) for manipulating quoting elements, like <blockquote> and <q>, but not the <cite> element.

HTMLOListElement.name: HTMLOListElement
HTMLOListElement.comment: Provides special properties (beyond those defined on the regular HTMLElement interface it also has available to it by inheritance) for manipulating ordered list elements.

HTMLUListElement.name: HTMLUListElement
HTMLUListElement.comment: Provides special properties (beyond those defined on the regular HTMLElement interface it also has available to it by inheritance) for manipulating unordered list elements.

HTMLLIElement.name: HTMLLIElement

value.name: value
value.comment: Sets or retrieves the value of a list item.
